text:
Maya (Growth Marketing): Hey team — Vireo Labs agreed to a case study. They can do a 30m interview next Tue/Thu morning. Want to kick this off: interview Qs, quote capture, legal signoff, webinar follow-up and routing to sales.
Sam (Content): Awesome. Can we lock a time first? I can draft the question set once we confirm.
Leila (Comms): I can run the quote capture flow and draft the short customer blurb for the site. Do we have permission to publish a logo/use of name?
Maya (Growth Marketing): They've already okayed a logo + short quote; legal needs the exact wording. Sam, target draft by EOD Fri?
Sam (Content): Yup — will push a draft to the folder. Quick poll for interview times:
```
Tue 9:30-10:00 PT
Thu 10:00-10:30 PT
```
Leila (Comms): Prefer Thu for US overlap. Also planning a 1-page case PDF and one 60s social cut — need any customer-approved screenshots?
Nina (Webinars): For the webinar follow-up: want to invite Vireo as a guest for a short 10-15m spotlight 2 weeks after publish? That drives leads. I can own the registration flow and nurture.
Phil (Legal): Quick checklist from my side: 1) signed case-study consent (simple template) 2) final quote approval email thread 3) logo asset terms (eps/png) 4) any PII redaction agreement. We can use our standard template — I'll drop it here.
Maya (Growth Marketing): Phil — can you drop the template now so we can add it to the calendar invite? Also need an explicit legal-ok by publish day + one backup quote if they retract.
Phil (Legal): Dropped template: https://redwood.company/legal/templates/case-study-consent-v1.docx. Please ensure customer signs before we publish; e-sign is fine. I can fast-track approval once the quote text is final.
Sam (Content): Draft Qs uploaded: https://drive.redwood/vireo/q-list.md. Short list: problem, why Redwood, workflow change, metrics (latency/cost), quote. @Leila can you pre-share the quote snippet to speed legal?
Leila (Comms): Will pull the quote lines during the interview and send two variants. Also sketching the 1-pager layout — will need product screenshots and a tiny architecture diagram. @Maya does Eng have a two-slide diagram we can use?
Maya (Growth Marketing): Eng: can we get a simple diagram (public-safe) — highlight model routing + dedicated config? If so, tag @DeployBot to fetch current diagram asset.
DeployBot: Retrieved public-safe arch diagram: https://assets.redwood/arch/public/v2/serve-diagram.png
Sam (Content): Sweet. I'll build the case doc using that. Timeline: interview next Thu, draft by following Mon, legal review Tue, publish Thurs the week after. Sound good?
Nina (Webinars): Sounds good. I'll schedule the webinar spotlight for 2 weeks post-publish and coordinate with CS for panel invite. Who will own lead routing? Want the inbound leads to go to AE queue + a special tag for case-study-sourced.
Leila (Comms): I can add the tag and coordinate with Sales Ops. @Maya can you loop Sales Ops for lead mapping?
Maya (Growth Marketing): On it. I'll ping Jordan in Sales Ops and ask for the tag + lead assignment rules.
Phil (Legal): One more note — if customer asks for edits to the quote post-interview, we require redline approval in writing. We'll keep a backup quote in case.
Sam (Content): Good call. I'll include that in the consent script during the interview.
Maya (Growth Marketing): Thanks everyone. Action items: Sam draft Qs (done), Leila quote variants + 1-pager assets, Phil send template (done), Nina webinar scheduling, Maya loop Sales Ops. I'll post the calendar invite once time's confirmed. :party_parrot: 
Leila (Comms): Filing checklist in /marketing/case-studies/vireo/ — will attach signed consent and final quote there.
Maya (Growth Marketing): Last thing — can we get a 1-sentence benchmark highlight for the social post (e.g., 2x latency reduction at 1/3 cost)? If metrics are fuzzy, mark as 'customer-reported' and flag to Legal.
Sam (Content): I'll have a metrics ask in the interview script. If they can't share exact numbers we can use percentage ranges.
Phil (Legal): Affirm — label all customer-provided metrics as 'customer-reported' unless we have an internal audit.
Maya (Growth Marketing): Perfect. OK I'll confirm final time with Vireo and send invite. Closing thread — please update the folder as you progress. :white_check_mark:
